objective: Estimate within-case scoring stability and presentation-order sensitivity without changing the judged texts, packet, rubric, or model configuration between order arms.

required_invariants: Retain each original X/Y draft byte-for-byte and bind both to a shared exact-byte digest.
Retain the same packet, judge prompt, rubric, model revision, generation parameters and tool policy in both arms.
Run at least two replicate pairs per case; each pair has one fresh isolated X_then_Y context and one fresh isolated Y_then_X context.
Present the same two drafts in each replicate pair; randomize the execution order of the four fresh contexts and record the allocation seed privately.
Use neutral draft identifiers; do not reveal R1 scores, preferences, declared assignments or answer keys to the judge.
Preserve raw model output and raw annotation before any source adjudication or correction.
Record failed calls, refusals, timeouts and unresolved source checks without deleting or regenerating them silently.
Represent every scheduled order slot as one run row. If it was not attempted, record call_outcome=not_attempted, judge_context_id=null, and null output/result fields; do not omit the row.

For every returned refusal or unparseable response, preserve the exact output in the authorized evidence store and record its SHA-256 plus an opaque artifact ID. Do not put local paths or private output text in the public record.
For timeouts and request errors, record whether any partial response bytes exist: digest and artifact ID are both present or both null.
Only call_outcome=valid_annotation has a parsed raw annotation and adjudication object. All other outcomes keep both nullable result fields null.
Keep a failed or unattempted order slot in its replicate pair; a retry uses a fresh replicate ID and contexts and does not replace the original slot.
primary_descriptive_measures: case-level preference flip between orders among comparable pairs
within-case X-minus-Y score-gap shift between orders among comparable pairs
per-dimension mean absolute score change for X and Y separately, averaging comparable replicate pairs within case before across-case summary
unresolved source-check counts by W4 state
analysis_limits: Do not treat dimensions, drafts or repeated judge calls as independent cases.
Do not calculate population claims or superiority/equivalence tests from this protocol alone.
Report denominators, failed/missing pairs and case-level values before aggregate summaries.
Report planned, comparable, incomplete, failed and not-attempted pairs and calls separately; the case count includes cases with zero comparable pairs.
A replicate pair is comparable only when both order slots have valid_annotation. Cases without a comparable pair remain in the report with null comparative metrics.
Never average X and Y rating changes together; report each draft and rubric dimension separately.

separate_calibration_run.rule: Source adjudication and any revised rubric must use a different run ID and packet. Never combine those scores with the order-only comparison.

resumption_gate: Obtain authorized exact X/Y draft bytes and source packet bytes, or explicitly create a separately labeled prospective replacement study.
Obtain original prompt, rubric and judge model/settings records. Unknown historical fields stay null; do not reconstruct them.
Freeze the current prompt, model revision/settings, allocation procedure, failure handling and analysis script before judging.
Keep the key, R1 scores and declared condition assignments outside the judge context until raw outputs and annotations are frozen.
human_evidence: not supplied by this model-only protocol

run_slot_fields.raw_output_sha256_and_ref: Both are null or both present. The ref is an opaque artifact ID, never a filesystem path.
run_slot_fields.raw_and_adjudicated: Non-null only for valid_annotation; both null for every other outcome.
run_slot_fields.judge_context_id: Required for every attempted call; null only for not_attempted.

outcome_evidence.valid_annotation: Requires output digest/reference, validated raw annotation and pending or complete adjudication.
outcome_evidence.refusal: Requires output digest/reference; annotation and adjudication are null.
outcome_evidence.invalid_annotation: Requires output digest/reference; annotation and adjudication are null.
outcome_evidence.timeout: May retain a partial output digest/reference; annotation and adjudication are null.
outcome_evidence.request_error: May retain any returned output digest/reference; annotation and adjudication are null.
outcome_evidence.not_attempted: Requires null context, output digest/reference, annotation and adjudication.

pair_rules.scheduled_pair: One X_then_Y and one Y_then_X run slot with the same replicate_id. Every slot is explicit, including not_attempted.
pair_rules.incomplete_pair: A scheduled pair with one or both slots lacking a valid annotation; retain it in all planned-pair denominators.
pair_rules.retry: A retry is a new replicate_id with fresh contexts; preserve the original failed/unattempted pair.

record_contract.zero_comparable_case: Keep the case row, report zero comparable pairs, and set comparative rates, shifts, profiles and score changes to null.
